mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (order_id, author_id, target_id, rating, content) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{authorId}, #{targetId}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.author_id, au.nickname AS author_nickname, au.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, r.target_id, tu.nickname AS target_nickname, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at FROM review r JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = r.author_id JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = r.target_id WHERE r.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY r.id

SELECT r.id, r.order_id, r.author_id, au.nickname AS author_nickname, au.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url, r.target_id, tu.nickname AS target_nickname, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at FROM review r JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = r.author_id JOIN sys_user tu ON tu.id = r.target_id WHERE r.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE target_id = #{targetId}
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(rating), 0) FROM review WHERE target_id = #{targetId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(rating), 0) FROM review WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}
